line_items.work_text: Approval of Rs. 313.69 Cr. under National Disaster Respond Fund (NDRF) based on the flood memorandum submitted by the Government of Assam for the year 2024

Water Resources Department informed that the department could not obtain vetting from Central Water Commission (CWC) on 48 proposals amounting to Rs. 511.83 for erosion protection works under XV FC and therefore, the department has now submitted 9 fresh proposals for River Erosion Mitigation works vetted by CWC Regional Office, Guwahati and TAC of the department amounting to Rs. 191.41 Cr.

narrative: SEC took note of the steps taken by ASDMA for setting up a PMU for implementation of the same. The meeting ended with a vote of thanks from the Chair.
